verdict.line: You win if you punish his W (Path Maker) whiffs and E (Shield Up!) cooldowns to snowball before level 9; you lose if lane stalls and he out-tanks you into the mid game.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's E (Shield Up!) directly answers Aatrox's frontal, physical burst by blocking/reducing it when raised, so your all-in has to be timed around that cooldown instead of dumped blindly into him. Before level 6 his W (Path Maker) is on a long cooldown and he has no ultimate, so your E-W-Q combo outpaces his damage; past that, his resistance stacking and CC start scaling harder than your damage does, so this is a lane you need to win fast, not grind out.

theirWindow.when: E (Shield Up!) is up and facing you
theirWindow.what: He can block or heavily reduce your Q3 knockup slam and empowered auto from the front. Don't dump your full combo into a raised shield — throw a single Q1 or auto first to bait it, or shift your angle before committing.

yourWindow.when: E just popped, or W (Path Maker) whiffed
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. E (Umbral Dash) in, drop W (Infernal Chains) for the root, and unload Q1-Q3 plus a woven Deathbringer's Stance auto — none of that damage gets absorbed while his shield or engage tool is down.

playing.title: Bait Shield Up before all-in
playing.detail: Throw a single auto or Q1 first to force him to raise E (Shield Up!) or waste it, then commit your real damage once it's down.

playing.title: Punish Path Maker whiffs
playing.detail: If his W misses a wall knockup, it's on a long cooldown at early ranks — immediately E-W-Q him while his engage/escape is gone.

playing.title: Track Ntofo Strikes stacks
playing.detail: Two visible Q stacks mean his next auto is empowered magic damage; don't trade autos blind into that unless you're already mid-combo.

playing.title: Respect the All Out gauge
playing.detail: His ultimate resource fills from sustained combat, not a flat cooldown. If you've been trading into him for several seconds, expect a mid-fight transform with bonus W range and true damage.

playing.title: Bank one E charge
playing.detail: Umbral Dash has two charges — save one to disengage after your combo instead of dumping both to close distance, or his wall knockup traps you with zero mobility left.

playing.title: Confirm Deathbringer's Stance first
playing.detail: Check your passive is up before committing the full combo; the bonus damage and heal are what swing the trade math in your favor.

playing.title: Close the game before nine items
playing.detail: Snowball plates and kills into a fast lead, since his tank stacking and CC scale better into a long game than your damage does.

brief.patchCaveat: Ability names and general kit (Ntofo Strikes, Path Maker, Shield Up!, All Out for K'Sante; Deathbringer's Stance, Darkin Blade, Infernal Chains, Umbral Dash, World Ender for Aatrox) should be current, but exact numbers — cooldowns, stack thresholds, shield energy values — drift patch to patch, so verify in-client. Item names (Eclipse, Sundered Sky, Black Cleaver, Death's Dance) reflect the standard Aatrox bruiser build as I know it; confirm availability and mythic/system changes on the live patch.
